$comment: Long-form consolidation of all government-office tenures, compiled to datasets/governments/governments_office_holdings.parquet by backend/yen_gov/canonical/office_holdings_seed.py. Carries CM holdings (G.1.c, 2026-05-22) plus the first official-source President/Vice President slice (2026-05-25); Governors are deferred to official Raj Bhavan/state-validated batches. To add a row: append to holdings[] and re-sort by (office_id, start_date) on next `python -m yen_gov emit-taxonomy --root .` run. Legacy CM rows may omit citation_group_id and use office_citations; non-CM rows cite citation_groups aligned to sources.parquet. Per-term `references` is optional and not consumed by the compile today (preserved for a future office_holding_annotations.parquet uplift). regime enum: elected | presidents_rule | governors_rule | interim | null. selection_method describes how the holder reaches office; tenure_status records substantive/acting/additional_charge. Person identity model: person_name is the verbatim publisher string; person_slug is derived in the seed; full dim_persons table is the §0e.5 follow-up. TCPD may seed/QA office rows, but official government sources are canonical provenance unless the user explicitly approves a fallback row.
